act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 48 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Schedule I-A Art. 48 (Power of Attorney): (a) 'When executed for sole purpose of procuring the registration of one or more documents in relation to a single transaction or for admitting execution of one or more such documents — Twenty rupees'; (c) 'When authorizing one person or more to act in a single transaction ... — Fifty rupees'.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (Schedule I-A reproduction). A special/single-transaction POA is encoded as Rs 50 (clause c). NOTE: a POA whose SOLE purpose is procuring registration/admitting execution (clause a) is Rs 20 — a lower, distinct case; not modelled separately here. Confirm whether special_poa should default to Rs 50 (act in a single transaction) or Rs 20 (registration-only), or be split by a questionnaire question. Confirm effective_from.
